scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test -- --forceExit; result=$?; npm --prefix indexer test -- --forceExit || result=1; npm --prefix frontend test -- --forceExit || result=1; exit $result
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint; result=$?; npm --prefix backend exec -- eslint --config backend/.eslintrc.json 'indexer/src/**/*.ts' || result=1; npm --prefix frontend run lint || result=1; exit $result
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build; result=$?; npm --prefix indexer run build || result=1; npm --prefix frontend run build || result=1; exit $result
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix backend run type-check; result=$?; npm --prefix indexer run type-check || result=1; npm --prefix frontend run type-check || result=1; exit $result
